messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool latency breach for customer 'Cygnus' in eu-central-1. Metric: inference.p99 = 4.2s (SLO 1.5s). Triggered at 2026-03-15T10:12:36Z. Opening thread for immediate triage.

nora: I'm on. Paging SRE + infra. @mira @alex you available?

mira:  here. pulling dashboards. p95 ~1.1s, p99 very high. Looks concentrated on pool dp-cc-eu-42 and tenant cygnus-prod-01.

alex: I see dp-cc-eu-42 GPUs at ~98% mem, kernels showing scheduling stalls. No deploys in the window.

paul: Did Cygnus recently change model or quantization? They were pinned to gpt-neo-16k-v2 q4.

jen: pinged Cygnus (Lars) on support channel. He says they had a burst of retries from a batch job.

mira: KV cache hit rate for cygnus-prod-01 dropped from ~88% -> ~22% at spike start. Suggests a cache invalidation flood. Errors remain low so it's latency-only.

nora: Options: (A) isolate tenant to spare pool, (B) scale pool by +nodes, (C) route tenant to fallback region, (D) apply tenant-level throttling. Immediate action should be minimal blast radius. Thoughts?

alex: Immediate: scale pool +2 nodes from reserved capacity. Running command now:
```
redwoodctl pools scale --pool dp-cc-eu-42 --add-nodes 2 --reason "p99 spike - cygnus"
```
Provision ETA ~90s. Noted several OOMs in model server logs pre-scale.

mira: While that boots, enabling tenant rate limit to protect other customers:
```
redwoodctl tenant update-rate --tenant cygnus-prod-01 --rps 40 --window 60s
```
Applying now, will observe 30s.

incident-bot: Action logged: infra.scale(dp-cc-eu-42,+2) + tenant.throttle(cygnus-prod-01,40rps). Pager update scheduled in 5m.

alex: New nodes joined. GPU pressure dropped to ~72%. p99 trending down to 1.8s.

mira: Attaching KV cache snapshot to speed warmup:
```
redwoodctl cache attach --tenant cygnus-prod-01 --snapshot sn-2026-03-15-08 --apply
```
Applied. KV hit climbed to ~65% after attach.

paul: If cache attach doesn't hold, fallback is pinning to smaller model variant (gpt-neo-8k-v2) for 10m:
```
redwoodctl tenant pin-model --tenant cygnus-prod-01 --model gpt-neo-8k-v2 --ttl 600
```
Plan-B ready.

jen: Lars: "We had a misconfigured retry loop on a nightly batch. I can pause it for 10m if that helps."

mira: After scaling + cache attach + throttle: p99 1.6s, p95 0.9s. Pool healthy. No error surge elsewhere.

nora: Good. Keep throttle for another 5m then relax slowly if stable. Confirm no cross-tenant regressions.

mira: No cross-tenant impact. Logging post-incident actions: investigate cache invalidation root cause, add pre-warm autoscaling for hot tenants, implement safer defaults for tenant rate limits.

paul: I will own feature: automatic model-fallthrough/pin when pool contention detected. Action: PAUL-2026-03.

alex: I'll own capacity automation improvements (faster spin-up path for dedicated pools). Action: ALEX-2026-03.

jen: I'll send customer follow-up and confirm they paused the job. Draft note: summary of incident, what we did, recommended fixes on their side.

mira: Snippet of logs showing KV miss flood (redacted):
```
[10:10:12] tenant=cygnus-prod-01 kv_miss=1423 per_min
[10:11:00] tenant=cygnus-prod-01 kv_miss=978 per_min
```
Need to correlate with customer job timestamps.

nora: Current state (2026-03-15T10:22Z): mitigated -> monitoring. p99 1.6s, target <1.5s. Throttle still active, cache snapshot attached. Will close if stable for 10m.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated. Actions recorded. Postmortem stub created.

paul: Postmortem ID PM-INC-2110001234. Assigning to me + mira.

mira: will add timeline, dashboards, and root-cause hypothesis.

alex: collecting node provisioning logs and kernel traces.

jen: customer confirmed pause. Will send EOD follow-up. :thumbsup: Lars appreciated the quick response.

nora: "Great work. Closing thread in 20m barring regressions. :heart:"
